typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

featureType.description: Type of the {@link FeatureBase} subtype linked to the current strategy as identified by {@link #featureId}

featureId.description: id of the {@link Feature} / {@link Feature.Set} associated with the current strategy.

snapshotId.description: {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot#snapshotId} of the {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot snapshot} if this strategy was used when the snapshot was created. Please note that binning strategy for a snapshot cannot be changed once created. So, {@link #init} will fail when invoked on a strategy instances which belong to a snapshot.

isReady.description:
if set, then the current strategy is **ready to be used operationally**. This is different from {@link Persistable.Bin.Strategy#isInitialized} because the "initialization" of the bins is not sufficient for them to be used to read data from associated {@link Feature.Store.Block blocks}. The associated data
should also be materialized for a strategy for it to be usable.

Please note that:
* The strategy itself has no way of knowing its own readiness and the responsibility lies with the data writers ("materialization") to update this when they have done their job. (after "re-binning")
* **isReady** will always be set for binning strategies of {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot snapshots}
* Only existence check (i.e **exists(isReady)**) will be used to determine readiness and the actual value will not be compared.

title: Binning strategy subtype to be used in Feature Store to bin ids of **FeatureEvaluatable** subtypes based on {@link Feature} and {@link Feature.Set} instances.
name: FeatureEvaluatable.Bin.Strategy
